In March–Spring 2014 PetSmart, with board authority, explored a merger with or acquisition of Industry Participant, which said it was not for sale and raised antitrust concerns (p. 21); from time to time third parties made undated inquiries about the Company's interest in a sale (p. 21).

facts.value: After weak results and pressure from JANA (9.9%) and Longview, PetSmart's board decided on 08/13/2014 to explore a sale and announced it on 08/19/2014, excluding Industry Participant on antitrust grounds. J.P. Morgan heard from 27 parties, and 15 financial buyers signed confidentiality and standstill agreements in early October. Six parties gave non-binding indications on 10/30/2014, and on 11/03 the board admitted the four at or above $80.00 to a final round; two of them then combined as Bidder 3. On 12/10 the Buyer Group bid $80.70 and Bidder 2 $80.35 while Bidder 3 dropped out at roughly the market price, and the committee demanded improved bids by 12/12. With Longview's approved rollover, the Buyer Group bid $83.00 best and final against Bidder 2's $81.50. The agreement was signed and announced on 12/14/2014.
